Record.name: Romp for the Rescues
Record.Description: "Romp" - (verb) To play or frolic in a lively or, loud and happy way. Our Mission is to unite communities through engaging events that drive awareness and raise critical funding for local animal rescue organizations.

Charity.name: Blessed Paws Animal Rescue
Charity.Description: Blessed Paws Animal Rescue saves dogs of all ages, sizes, and breeds, to protect them from the life of being abandoned, abused or neglected. We strive to provide a positive change for animal welfare in a variety of ways. We are 100% volunteer and foster based!

Charity.name: Wild Whiskers
Charity.Description: We rewrite futures through Trap-Neuter-Vaccinate-Return, creating thriving neighborhoods for cats and people alike. Founded by passionate advocate Brittany Mason, we believe Trap-Neuter-Vaccinate-Return (TNVR) is the only compassionate and effective solution for these cats.
